ORGANIZATIONAL PROFILE

## Keeping a global team connected and aligned

Paramount delivers entertainment content to audiences worldwide through a multitude of brands across all platforms. It’s ranked in the top 100 of the Fortune 500. In 2020, Paramount had $26 billion in revenue and 4.3 billion subscribers across 180+ countries. The company has 22,000 employees globally.

THE CHALLENGE

## Connecting every team

A major merger left Paramount needing to unite a sprawling global workforce. They knew that clear, consistent communication and engaging content were key to a more aligned, productive, and creative team. But they were battling a system that was holding them back:  An outdated on-premise system that was costly and lacked flexibility.

- Simple tasks become time-consuming, forcing teams to juggle multiple machines, software, and a challenging user interface.
- Platform limitations led to escalating production and equipment expenses.
- Their existing space reservation software was failing to meet modern expectations, especially among younger employees.
- Ingesting and distributing live content was a major roadblock.

As a leader in entertainment, Paramount knew they had to modernize their employee communications and distribution channels to stay ahead.

THE SOLUTION

## Advanced communication capabilities integrated with robust workplace reservation software

Paramount chose Appspace after carefully evaluating several options for both [digital signage](https://www.appspace.com/digital-signage/) and [workplace reservations](https://www.appspace.com/space-reservation/). They were impressed by Appspace’s advanced features and ability to scale globally. Paramount also saw the potential for a long-term partnership with Appspace – one that could adapt and grow with their evolving needs.

Appspace’s commitment to continuous platform improvement was a key factor in their decision.

The pandemic led Paramount to prioritize [employee engagement](https://www.appspace.com/culture-engagement/) even more. They also realized that many pandemic-era workplace changes would permanently affect how they communicate with employees. Appspace’s scalable platform was perfect for Paramount’s global reach, allowing them to [deliver consistent messages](https://www.appspace.com/orchestration/) across all locations. This international rollout helped them move away from relying solely on emails for employee communication and explore other ways to connect with employees throughout the company.

Appspace provides Paramount with a [unified platform](https://www.appspace.com/platform-overview/) that offers customization, simplified content management, integration options, and a library of resources and templates. Plus, it brings together digital signage, workplace reservations, and an [employee app](https://www.appspace.com/employee-mobile-app/), creating a more impactful experience for everyone across the organization.

THE RESULTS

- 4x more efficient than the previous provider
- 20 countries using digital signage and space reservation
- 10,000+ global employees deployed on workplace reservations
